_comment: BluePilot Visuals Settings - Merged from SunnyPilot VisualsPanel + existing BP Visuals menu

controls.title: Enhanced Onroad UI
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Enable enhanced lane lines, road edges, and path rendering with glow effects and curve smoothing.

controls.title: Custom Model Path Color
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Customize the color of the driving path overlay

controls.title: Show Animated Steer Angle Icon
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Animates Comma icon based on steering angle.

controls.title: Show Brake Status
controls.desc:
[BluePilot] Changes the speed color to red when the brake is pressed.
(This setting is only tested on F150s at this time.)

controls.title: Show Blind Spot Warnings
controls.desc: Enabling this will display warnings when a vehicle is detected in your blind spot as long as your car has BSM supported.

controls.title: Show Stop Indicator Overlay
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Displays a stop indicator overlay when it detects a stop point.

controls.title: Show Wide Camera at Low Speed
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Show the wide camera at low speed.

controls.title: Enable Tesla Rainbow Mode
controls.desc:
A beautiful rainbow effect on the path the model wants to take.
It does not affect driving in any way.

controls.title: Display Road Name
controls.desc: Displays the name of the road the car is traveling on. The OpenStreetMap database of the location must be downloaded from the OSM panel to fetch the road name.

controls.title: Speedometer: Always Display True Speed
controls.desc: Always display the true vehicle current speed from wheel speed sensors.

controls.title: Speedometer: Hide from Onroad Screen
controls.desc: When enabled, the speedometer on the onroad screen is not displayed.

controls.title: Display Turn Signals
controls.desc: When enabled, visual turn indicators are drawn on the HUD.

controls.title: Show Radar Lead Vehicle Overlay
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Displays radar data lead vehicle overlay.

controls.title: Radar Lead Vehicle Overlay Size
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Adjusts the size of the radar lead vehicle overlay

allConditionsTrue.reason: Requires Radar Lead Vehicle Overlay to be enabled

controls.title: Show Hybrid Electric Data Overlays
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Displays hybrid electric vehicle data.

allConditionsTrue.reason: Vehicle does not support hybrid electric data

controls.title: Show Hybrid Battery Data Overlays
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Displays hybrid battery data.

allConditionsTrue.reason: Requires Hybrid Electric Data Overlays to be enabled
Vehicle does not support hybrid electric data
Vehicle does not support hybrid battery data

controls.title: Hybrid Drive Gauge Size
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Adjusts the size of the hybrid drive gauge

allConditionsTrue.reason: Requires Hybrid Electric Data Overlays to be enabled

controls.title: Show G-Force Meter
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Displays a g-force meter when onroad.
controls._comment: DISABLED: G-Force meter disabled for performance/consistency issues

controls.title: Enable Standstill Timer
controls.desc: Show a timer on the HUD when the car is at a standstill.

controls.title: Enable BluePilot Alert UI
controls.desc: [BluePilot] Enable BluePilot visual alert design with modern styling, smooth animations, and enhanced readability.

controls.title: Green Traffic Light Alert (Beta)
controls.desc:
A chime and on-screen alert will play when the traffic light you are waiting for turns green and you have no vehicle in front of you.

Note: This chime is only designed as a notification. It is the driver's responsibility to observe their environment and make decisions accordingly.

controls.title: Lead Departure Alert (Beta)
controls.desc:
A chime and on-screen alert will play when you are stopped, and the vehicle in front of you start moving.

Note: This chime is only designed as a notification. It is the driver's responsibility to observe their environment and make decisions accordingly.

controls.title: Display Metrics Below Chevron
controls.desc: Display useful metrics below the chevron that tracks the lead car (only applicable to cars with openpilot longitudinal control).

descriptions.default: Display useful metrics below the chevron that tracks the lead car (only applicable to cars with openpilot longitudinal control).
descriptions.offroad: Start the vehicle to check vehicle compatibility.
descriptions.noLong: This feature requires openpilot longitudinal control to be available.

allConditionsTrue.reason: Start the vehicle to enable this setting

controls.title: Developer UI
controls.desc: Display real-time parameters and metrics from various sources.
